verdict.rationale: Logseq's block reference syntax `(())` embeds/transcludes an individual block from any page into another, and page references `[[]]` do the same at page level; since Logseq's block-based architecture keeps a single canonical block that references simply render/link to, edits propagate automatically, keeping transclusions in sync. Docs explicitly describe both block and page referencing as core features. Missing for 10: no explicit doc quote confirming live-sync behavior on edit (implied by architecture, not directly demonstrated) and no independent hands-on confirmation of transclusion sync specifically.
